description: This PHP class 'AdminUserAPI' is a REST API controller handling POST and GET requests for managing administrator user data during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with request data, performs validation, and uses a state container to store and retrieve admin user information.

classes.name: AdminUserAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for managing administrator user data during installation, supporting creation and retrieval of admin user info.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to create or update admin user data, validating input fields and storing data in the state container.

methods.name: checkAndGetField
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a specific field from the request, throwing an exception if the field is missing or empty.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Retrieves stored admin user data from the state container and returns it in a structured response.
